description:
The Electro-Light TNT Scooter takes playtime to the next level with Infinity Mirror LEDs glowing across the deck, wheels, and front plate. Five lighting modes and motion-activated color effects create a tunnel of dazzling light that makes every ride feel exciting and full of energy.
With the Tilt ’n’ Turn steering system, kids can lean, steer, and balance naturally as they ride. The wide, non-slip deck and sturdy rear foot brake help them stay steady and in control—making it the perfect scooter for building early riding confidence.
Ergonomic handlebar grips give small hands a comfortable, secure hold, while the adjustable handlebar height grows with your child. It’s designed to fit just right through every stage of fun and learning.
A durable steel frame keeps up with active play, while protected LED housings keep the lights safe through every spin, lean, and glide. It’s built strong, bright, and ready for endless adventure.
Ideal for ages 3 and up, this scooter fits riders 37" and taller and supports up to 44 lbs. Lightweight, stable, and full of glow, it’s the perfect choice for kids ready to roll into independence.
